text: Hello, everybody.Welcome to today's class.After reading quite a few friendship stories, today, we are going to deal with the writing part, and I'm looking forward to hearing some friendship stories from you.By the end of this period, you are expected to write an informal thank you letter with proper content and format, understand the importance of sending sincere thanks to friends.We cherish friendship a lot in our life, and July the 30th is set as International Friendship Day to celebrate our precious friendship.So today, we are going to take advantage of this special day to convey our gratitude through a thank you letter.Please open your book and turn to page 30.Read the friendship day poster to find out its purpose.You will have one minute.Thank you.So, what is the purpose of the International Friendship Day?To promote dialogue, acceptance and understanding between people of different backgrounds.Yes, these are the most important components in any friendship.When your friends comfort you with patience, accept your shortcomings or understand your bad temper, what would you say to them?I guess thank you might be the answer shared by all.We've learned quite a few stories about friendship, and I'm wondering what friendship means to you.Would you please use a noun or non-phrase to present your definition of friendship in the first box?Answers may vary, and based on your definition of friendship, who would you like to show appreciation for?Please write down the name of the person in the second box.The person you wrote down might have saved you from trouble, helped you at all costs, or simply made you laugh.Now, please brainstorm words and phrases to describe his or her actions and your feelings.If necessary, you can refer to the vocabulary chart of this unit.You will have two minutes.I'm really glad to see your efforts in finding verbs to highlight your friendship story.But here, compared with pet, invite, and train, help seems to be too general.Based on the process of solving a math problem, we can further specify, help me with math problems as, locate the error, select the right pattern, and demonstrate the calculations.You can check your own story and find out if any verb needs to be specified.Sunny, what improvements did you make?I changed the phrase, accompany me when I'm upset, into sit quietly with me, send me a comfort letter, or give me a warm hug when I'm upset.Great.In that case, readers can easily picture the scene.Now, please write the draft of your thank you letter.Remember to express your gratitude clearly.State the reason why you are grateful based on the chart.You will have three minutes.读书的时间到,让我们读一下Candy的写书和讨论它需要什么改善,根据您的工作库中的内容检测标课。请在写书中写出来,并准备一些评论。读书的时间到,让我们读一下Candy的写书和讨论。好的,让我们来听听评论。首先,她的写书明显示了为什么她感谢某些词。奥迪维,请。是的,她写出了帮助于更多的某些词。用词的用法,写出了更多的评论。是的,Candy已经在用词中进行了一些进展。请记住,写书会变得更困难,使用特定的词。然后,她是否使用正确和分开的表达表达感谢?我认为,她写出了与线之间的真实感谢。然而,她三次向你道谢。我正在想,如果可以使用更多的表达表达感谢。例如,我非常感谢你的帮助。其实,可以使用更多的表达表达感谢。你还知道什么?很多感谢。非常感谢你。是的,他们全都是代表感谢。你可以使用他们在写书中。最后,她写出了任何严重的评论。Tina,请。我认为,第二个词的最后一句话应该删除。因为,她写出了感谢的表达表达感谢。而且,这与Judy的教授的评论无关。评论应该永远与写书有关。感谢你的评论。现在,请查看您的自己的专辑,根据您的内容检测,并写出更好的版本。您有两分钟。让我们读一下Candy写的新版本。到现在,您已经完成了专辑中的专辑的专辑的专辑。我们刚刚学会了专辑中的专辑。除了专辑,其他部份都应该有什么?我们刚刚读到的专辑。专辑有ж专辑我们读了 тип词我们读了宛专辑到て您先说说。我们看十方面,喂。dominant是。seedsosing是。风请在第32个页面上浏览比较,并关注分别。今天的课程请在130个字中写出一封感谢词,给一位成年朋友,例如教授或家人。感谢词只需要几分钟。但它们很沉重。下一次,如果您想向某人道谢,您可以写一封感谢词。今天就到此为止,下次见!
